Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_EnforceSetting: Enforce these settings for all players

Multiplayer only. Off by default: every player uses their own Cone Vision Outline options (Settings -> Mods). When on, the settings below replace each player's own, and changing them in the mod options has no effect. The outline colour stays the player's choice. Has no effect in singleplayer.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ConeOutlineAlp: Outline opacity, 0 to 1 (default 0.3). Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_LegacyOutlineM: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: use the old square-visibility check instead of asking the game which zombies and animals it draws.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_ScaleOutlineBy: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: the outline fades as the light on the target drops, and is gone in full darkness. Turn this on to stop outlines giving away zombies in the dark.
Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: outlines fade with distance in fog.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAlwaysO: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: outlines are shown all the time, not only while aiming (RMB).
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_VehicleOutline: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: in a vehicle, outlines are shown without holding RMB.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutline_OutlineAnimals: Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: animals are outlined along with zombies.
